summary: Konami's 1986 World Endurance Championship racing arcade game, famous for its deluxe rotating cockpit cabinet simulating Le Mans driving forces.

entries.title: WEC Le Mans

emulation.notes: MAME preserves the arcade software; original deluxe hardware is required for the full rotating-cabinet physical effect.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Konami Dual 68000 arcade presentation with modern scaling; physical cabinet motion only on original deluxe hardware

primary.version: Original Konami arcade release, preferably deluxe rotating cockpit
primary.why: WEC Le Mans was designed as a Konami arcade racing simulation and shipped in upright, mini-spin, and deluxe big-spin cabinet versions; the deluxe arcade cabinet physically rotates and vibrates to simulate driving forces. The arcade version, especially the deluxe cabinet, is therefore the highest-fidelity and most complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the arcade version in MAME/original hardware; for full intended fidelity, use the deluxe rotating cockpit cabinet where available.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Konami Dual 68000 arcade release with upright, mini-spin, and deluxe big-spin cabinet variants.
all_releases.reason: primary: original and highest-fidelity route; deluxe cabinet adds the intended motion hardware.
